independent_observational_source_grain: 185 radio brood clusters, 2069 observed used points and 74000 400-per-brood GENERATED available sample points; no dated selected wetland visits
limitations: The 400 generated available points per brood are pseudo-alternatives within 2.4 km of nest, not 400 truly documented wetland options
Undated habitat use cannot be aligned with radio brood Duckling Age and movement Distance from Nest to test future wetland choice
No brood prior-use history was used; this is out-of-brood static habitat attribute predictive transfer, not cognitive/episodic memory
Training and heldout broods may sample same wetlands/landscape; no geographic external species replication
Original source Weight=1000 for available has another analysis-specific meaning; own group-balanced training weights were used
No true animal resource intake, prey abundance, fitness, pairwise social alignment or 3D niche observed
